text: Luxurious Rooms: | Where Every View is a Masterpiece | Welcome to our luxurious retreat where every aspect is meticulously designed to offer you an unparalleled experience. Our resort boasts three air-conditioned bedrooms, each uniquely showcasing a breathtaking view of our lush tea plantation. With expansive glass doors and windows, you'll enjoy the best vistas right from the comfort of your room. Experience the epitome of luxury and natural beauty at our homestay. | Room 1 | With panoramic glass windows offering a rich view of the surroundings, a shaded balcony providing easy access to the pool under the canopy of a mango tree, and an attached toilet featuring a stunning glass window framing mountain sunsets, every moment here is a blend of luxury and natural beauty, ensuring an unforgettable stay. | Room 2 | Step onto your private grass lawn and enjoy sunset chats with a refreshing breeze. With easy access to the grill house and tea plantation walk, every moment here is filled with relaxation and exploration. Plus, the attached toilet's glass window offers a wide view of the hills, adding to the charm of your stay. | Room 3 | Our largest and most luxurious accommodation at the homestay. This spacious room features a side glass window that offers a stunning view of our lush garden, creating a serene ambience. With direct access to the infinity pool, you can easily unwind and enjoy a refreshing dip whenever you please. It is designed for ultimate comfort and relaxation. | Book Now | Booking Policies & Guidelines | ● | Please note that all activities related to fireworks are strictly prohibited on our property and its premises. | ● | Bookings will be only confirmed upon receipt of advance payment. | ● | On weekends, we prioritize full-property bookings. (Friday, Saturday& Sunday). | ● | We kindly request you to confirm your booking as soon as possible. For multiple inquiries on the same day, bookings will be processed on a first-come, first-served basis. | ● | Please note, all guests must share their valid ID proof during check-in. | ● | Children above 6 years old will be considered in the adult category and will be charged accordingly. | ● | Check In:14:00 Hrs & Check-Out: 11:00 Hrs ( IST) | ● | Early check-in & Late check-out is subject to availability and will be chargeable. Checkouts from 11:00 to 18:00 hours are subject to 50% of the room rate and after that at 100%. | ● | Please complete the balance payment procedure during the check-in time. | ● | Please remember, that the number of guests must not exceed as mentioned in the confirmation. During the stay, no guests other than those who have made a reservation may enter the property. | ● | We kindly request that guests confirm their food choices two days before arrival. The menu lists will be provided to you when booking for your convenience. | ● | For the health, safety, and quality standards of our guests, we do not permit outside food on our property. | ● | Complimentary breakfast is provided, and guests can select up to three main courses from the food menu. | ● | Negotiation is not possible after reaching the property. | ● | The late check-in must be informed to the property manager. | ● | Early check-in & Late check-out are subject to availability and must be informed beforehand. | ● | Smoking and alcohol consumption is allowed in designated areas only. | ● | We strictly prohibit all illegal activities, including gambling, prostitution, and narcotics. | ● | Damage to the property caused by the guest will be charged at the cost of repair or replacement. | ● | We appreciate your cooperation and respect for the property staff. Please treat them with kindness and courtesy. | ● | Please take care of yourself if you engage in adventure activities on the property. | ● | We kindly request you to take good care of your belongings. Please note that these activities incur additional charges. | ● | All the special requests by the guest are subject to availability upon arrival. | ● | For any disputes in payments and any other legal disputes, the jurisdiction of the court will be at Muttom in Idukki district Kerala | Cancellation Policy | ● | In case of no show or cancellation of the reservation, the resort has the right to levy retention charges. | ● | Guests who cancel their reservation at least 7 days before arrival will receive a 90% refund of the advance amount. | ● | Guests who cancel their reservation at least 3 days before arrival will receive a 50% refund of the advance amount. | ● | Cancellations before 0-3 days before the arrival are not entitled to a refund. | ● | Reservations cancelled between December 20th and January 10th are not eligible for any refund.
